chapterInfo.content:
2
Satan sane sɔ Hiob hwɛ
1 # Hiob 1.6 Na da bi nso Ɔsoro dɔm sane baa sɛ wɔrebɛgyina AWURADE anim, na Satan nso dii wɔn mu baa sɛ ɔrebɛgyina AWURADE anim bi. 2Na AWURADE bisaa Satan sɛ: Ɛhe na wofiri baeɛ yi? Na Satan buaa AWURADE sɛ: Mefiri asase so kyini ne ɛso anantenanteɛ na mereba. 3#Hiob 1.1 Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Satan sɛ: Woadwene m’akoa Hiob ho? Na obiara nni hɔ a ɔte sɛ ɔno asase so, ɔbarima a ɔdi mu na ɔtene, ɔsuro Onyankopɔn, na ɔyi ne ho firi bɔne ho; nanso ɔda so kura ne mudie no mu ara, na wo Satan woahwanyan me atia no sɛ mensɛe no kwa. 4Na Satan buaa AWURADE sɛ: Wɔde wedeɛ pere wedeɛ, na deɛ onipa wɔ nyinaa, ɔde ma pere ne kra. 5Na afei tene wo nsa na ka ne dompe ne ne nam, sɛ ɔrennome wo ntɛm ara anaa! 6Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Satan sɛ: Hwɛ, ɔni, ɔwɔ wo nsam, ne nkwa nko na kora. 7Ɛnna Satan firii AWURADE anim kɔeɛ, na ɔde akuro bɔne kɔtutuu Hiob firi ne nan ase kɔsii ne mpampam. 8Na ɔfaa kyɛmferɛ bi sɛ ɔde redwi ne ho na ɔtenaa nso mu.
9 # Hiob 19.17 Na ne yere bisaa no sɛ: Woda so kura wo mudie no mu ara? Dome Onyankopɔn, na wu! 10#Hiob 1.22; Yak 5.12 Na ɔbuaa no sɛ: Sɛdeɛ mmaa agyegyentwie no mu bi kasa na wokasa yi. Yɛagye Nyankopɔn hɔ adepa, na adebɔne na yɛrennye anaa? Yei nyinaa mu no Hiob amfa n’ano anyɛ bɔne.
Hiob nnamfonom bɛsra no
11 # Gye 36.15; Yer 49.7; Gye 25.2; Yos 15.41 Na Hiob nnamfo baasa tee amanehunu a aba ne soɔ yi nyinaa no, wɔn mu biara firi deɛ ɔwɔ bae, Temanni Elifas ne Suhini Bildad ne Naamani Sofar, na wɔbɛhyiaa sɛ wɔrebɛgyam no na wɔakyekyere ne werɛ. 12Na wɔfiri akyirikyiri memaa wɔn ani so, na wɔhunuu no no, wɔanhu no. Na wɔmemaa wɔn nne so sui, na wɔsunsuanee wɔn ntadeɛ mu, na wɔtoo mfuturo kɔɔ soro guu wɔn atifi. 13Na wɔne no tenatenaa fam nnanson adekyeeɛ ne adesaeɛ, na obiara ne no ankasa, ɛfiri sɛ wɔhunuu sɛ n’amanehunu no so pa ara.

Na da bi nso Ɔsoro dɔm sane baa sɛ wɔrebɛgyina AWURADE anim, na Satan nso dii wɔn mu baa sɛ ɔrebɛgyina AWURADE anim bi. Na AWURADE bisaa Satan sɛ: Ɛhe na wofiri baeɛ yi? Na Satan buaa AWURADE sɛ: Mefiri asase so kyini ne ɛso anantenanteɛ na mereba. Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Satan sɛ: Woadwene m’akoa Hiob ho? Na obiara nni hɔ a ɔte sɛ ɔno asase so, ɔbarima a ɔdi mu na ɔtene, ɔsuro Onyankopɔn, na ɔyi ne ho firi bɔne ho; nanso ɔda so kura ne mudie no mu ara, na wo Satan woahwanyan me atia no sɛ mensɛe no kwa. Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Satan sɛ: Hwɛ, ɔni, ɔwɔ wo nsam, ne nkwa nko na kora. Ɛnna Satan firii AWURADE anim kɔeɛ, na ɔde akuro bɔne kɔtutuu Hiob firi ne nan ase kɔsii ne mpampam. Na ɔfaa kyɛmferɛ bi sɛ ɔde redwi ne ho na ɔtenaa nso mu.
Na ne yere bisaa no sɛ: Woda so kura wo mudie no mu ara? Dome Onyankopɔn, na wu! Na ɔbuaa no sɛ: Sɛdeɛ mmaa agyegyentwie no mu bi kasa na wokasa yi. Yɛagye Nyankopɔn hɔ adepa, na adebɔne na yɛrennye anaa? Yei nyinaa mu no Hiob amfa n’ano anyɛ bɔne.

Na Hiob nnamfo baasa tee amanehunu a aba ne soɔ yi nyinaa no, wɔn mu biara firi deɛ ɔwɔ bae, Temanni Elifas ne Suhini Bildad ne Naamani Sofar, na wɔbɛhyiaa sɛ wɔrebɛgyam no na wɔakyekyere ne werɛ. Na wɔne no tenatenaa fam nnanson adekyeeɛ ne adesaeɛ, na obiara ne no ankasa, ɛfiri sɛ wɔhunuu sɛ n’amanehunu no so pa ara.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
